# Always Scheming Terminal (AST) – Discoverability File

## Description
Always Scheming Terminal (AST) is a gaming‑industry intelligence platform delivering signals, briefs, and entity tracking for investors and analysts.

## Pages
-Welcome page – `/` – landing with ticker and feed
-Login – `/login` – authentication portal
-API explorer – `/api-explorer` – interactive API documentation and testing

## API Endpoints
### v1 REST API
- GET `/api/v1/entities` – retrieve gaming industry entities with optional filtering by alias, entity_type, and pagination
- GET `/api/v1/signals` – retrieve investment signals with deduplication and clustering
- GET `/api/v1/sources` – list active news sources
- GET `/api/v1/items` – retrieve news articles with filtering by source, signal type, date range, and pagination
- GET `/api/v1/openapi.json` – serve OpenAPI specification
- GET `/api/v1/entity-aliases` – retrieve alias-to-canonical mapping; POST – admin-only creation of new alias
- GET `/api/v1/health` – health check endpoint
- POST `/api/v1/brief` – generate a brief answering a query using RAG over gaming industry news

All endpoints except `/api/v1/health` and public alias lookups require an API key (Bearer token).

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Endpoint: `/api/mcp` (streamable‑http, requires API key)
- Discovery: `/.well-known/mcp.json` – lists available tools (`ast_get_signals`, `ast_get_items`, `ast_get_entities`, `ast_brief`)

## Data
-Live news items (articles) with titles, bodies, sources, publishing dates
-Investment signals (M&A, fundraising, earnings, partnerships) extracted from articles via LLM
-Gaming industry entities (companies, exchanges, tickers, segments) with canonical names and aliases
-Briefs synthesized via RAG (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite) answering natural‑language queries

## LLM Usage
# LLM Usage Disclosure
Application: Always Scheming Terminal (AST)
Purpose: Gaming‑industry intelligence signals and briefs
LLM Use Cases:
- Generating synthesized intelligence briefs via RAG
- Extracting investment signals (M&A, fundraising, earnings, etc.) from news articles
- Answering natural‑language queries about gaming‑industry news
Model: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite (Google AI API)
Data Sent: Queries and retrieved article content only; no personally identifiable information.
Data Retention: No persistent storage of LLM interactions beyond audit logs.
Contact: See /api/v1/openapi.json for API documentation.
